text:
Hanover’s median asking rent sits at 11.38 €/m², up 4.3 % year‑on‑year and 24.6 % over the past five years, placing the city 19th among the 37 most expensive German markets. The asking premium over existing rents is 58 %, with a typical 60 m² apartment costing about 683 € per month.

The market remains balanced but tight: listings stay on the market for an average of 27 days, only 26 % are let within a week, and the vacancy rate is 2.2 %. Rent‑burden for two residents is 15.3 %, while mortgage rates sit at 4.01 %.

A model estimate forecasts the median asking rent to reach 12.04 €/m² in 12 months, ranging between 11.72 €/m² and 12.33 €/m², indicating continued modest growth.
